exclusion.reason: Alibaba’s exact qwen3.8-max-prime pricing row explicitly links to Fast mode (Prime). Its Chinese Prime guide says supported model capabilities and limits remain those of the original model and describes speed, billing, rate limits and mode-specific identifiers. Vercel corroborates that Prime is the high-speed edition of Max retaining its architecture and full capabilities. These sources identify a serving mode of the existing Max model, without documenting an independently trained Prime release. Exclude the serving-tier duplicate from independent-model counts while preserving its frozen audit record. This is not a claim of byte-identical deployed tensors or an exact Max-0902 snapshot mapping, and is independent of the unresolved SKU launch date.
